connector.name: PineLabs Plural PG - Payment Gateway MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Create payment orders, checkout, subscriptions & UPI via PineLabs Plural PG gateway
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.pinelabs.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package pinelabs-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the plural-pinelabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
